description: The rankings of a game for one (neblla.scores; boards declared with neblla_update_app({ scores })). action "top": the best of a board, { board, period: "all" (default) | "day" (today, UTC), limit (≤ 100) } → [{ place, player, value, at, info }]; action "player": one user's standing { board, player } → { best, bestAt, dayBest, runs, place } or null; action "remove": take a user's score off a board { board, player } (a cheat that got in). Refused scores never enter: they are in the app log (neblla_get_logs, area score).

player.description: The user id in the app

name: neblla_scores
